∀ (a b : ℝ) (f w : KdVPlan.Coeff), a≤b → KdVPlan.Smooth f → KdVPlan.Smooth w → KdVPlan.ZeroMean f → KdVPlan.ZeroMean w →
KdVPlan.tri a b (fun _ => f) (fun _ => f) (fun _ => f) =
KdVPlan.tri a b (fun _ => f-w) (fun _ => f) (fun _ => f)+
KdVPlan.tri a b (fun _ => w) (fun _ => f-w) (fun _ => f)+
KdVPlan.tri a b (fun _ => w) (fun _ => w) (fun _ => f-w)+
KdVPlan.tri a b (fun _ => w) (fun _ => w) (fun _ => w)
proof:
intro a b f w hab hsf hsw hzf hzw
have hnorm := yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013
have hdS : KdVPlan.Smooth (f-w) := fun m => (hnorm.1 m f w (hsf m) (hsw m)).1
have hzd : KdVPlan.ZeroMean (f-w) := by change f 0-w 0=0; rw [hzf,hzw]; ring
have hpc := yui_aux_0063 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013
have htri : ∀ x y z, KdVPlan.Smooth x → KdVPlan.Smooth y → KdVPlan.Smooth z → KdVPlan.ZeroMean x → KdVPlan.ZeroMean y → KdVPlan.ZeroMean z →
KdVPlan.timeInt a b (fun r => KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r x y) z)=KdVPlan.tri a b (fun _=>x) (fun _=>y) (fun _=>z) := by
  intro x y z hx hy hz hzx hzy hzz
  exact h_T005.2.2.2.1 a b _ _ _ hab (hpc a b x hx) (hpc a b y hy) (hpc a b z hz) (fun _ _ => ⟨hzx,hzy,hzz⟩)
have hcont : ∀ x y z, KdVPlan.Smooth x → KdVPlan.Smooth y → KdVPlan.Smooth z →
KdVPlan.ContH 1 a b (fun r => KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r x y) z) := by
  intro x y z hx hy hz
  have hcx := (yui_aux_0030 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 1 a b x (by simpa using hx 1)
  have hcy := (yui_aux_0030 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 1 a b y (by simpa using hy 1)
  have hcz := (yui_aux_0030 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 0 a b z (by simpa using hz 0)
  exact (yui_aux_0041 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.2 a b _ _ ((yui_aux_0041 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.1 a b _ _ hcx hcy) hcz
have hmB : ∀ r x y, KdVPlan.Smooth x → KdVPlan.Smooth y → KdVPlan.MemH 0 (KdVPlan.B r x y) := by
  rcases (yui_aux_0019 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.2.1 with ⟨C,hC,hB⟩
  exact fun r x y hx hy => (hB r x y (by simpa using hx 1) (by simpa using hy 1)).1
have hf0 : KdVPlan.MemH 0 f := by simpa using hsf 0
have hw0 : KdVPlan.MemH 0 w := by simpa using hsw 0
have hd0 : KdVPlan.MemH 0 (f-w) := by simpa using hdS 0
have hsum : f-w+w=f := sub_add_cancel f w
have hbadd := yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013
have hjadd := yui_aux_0011 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013
have hpoint : ∀ r, KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r f f) f =
 KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r (f-w) f) f+KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r w (f-w)) f+KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r w w) (f-w)+KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r w w) w := by
  intro r
  have hB1 : KdVPlan.B r f f=KdVPlan.B r (f-w) f+KdVPlan.B r w f := by
    rw [← (hbadd r (f-w) w f f hd0 hw0 hf0 hf0).1,hsum]
  have hB2 : KdVPlan.B r w f=KdVPlan.B r w (f-w)+KdVPlan.B r w w := by
    rw [← (hbadd r w w (f-w) w hw0 hw0 hd0 hw0).2,hsum]
  rw [hB1,hB2]
  have hbdf := hmB r (f-w) f hdS hsf
  have hbwd := hmB r w (f-w) hsw hdS
  have hbww := hmB r w w hsw hsw
  have hbs := (yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 0 _ _ hbwd hbww
  rw [(hjadd r _ _ f f hbdf hbs.1 hf0 hf0).1,(hjadd r _ _ f f hbwd hbww hf0 hf0).1]
  have hlast : KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r w w) f=KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r w w) (f-w)+KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r w w) w := by
    rw [← (hjadd r _ _ (f-w) w hbww hbww hd0 hw0).2,hsum]
  rw [hlast]; abel
rw [← htri f f f hsf hsf hsf hzf hzf hzf,
 ← htri (f-w) f f hdS hsf hsf hzd hzf hzf,
 ← htri w (f-w) f hsw hdS hsf hzw hzd hzf,
 ← htri w w (f-w) hsw hsw hdS hzw hzw hzd,
 ← htri w w w hsw hsw hsw hzw hzw hzw]
funext k
change (∫ r in a..b, KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r f f) f k) = _
have hint : ∀ x y z, KdVPlan.Smooth x → KdVPlan.Smooth y → KdVPlan.Smooth z →
IntervalIntegrable (fun r=>KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r x y) z k) volume a b := by
  intro x y z hx hy hz
  exact yui_aux_0065 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 a b _ hab (yui_aux_0031 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 1 a b _ (hcont x y z hx hy hz) k)
have h1 := hint (f-w) f f hdS hsf hsf
have h2 := hint w (f-w) f hsw hdS hsf
have h3 := hint w w (f-w) hsw hsw hdS
have h4 := hint w w w hsw hsw hsw
calc
 _ = ∫ r in a..b, (KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r (f-w) f) f k+KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r w (f-w)) f k+KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r w w) (f-w) k+KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r w w) w k) := by
   apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr; intro r _; exact congrFun (hpoint r) k
 _ = _ := by
   rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add ((h1.add h2).add h3) h4,intervalIntegral.integral_add (h1.add h2) h3,intervalIntegral.integral_add h1 h2]
   rfl
